postParser.tip.aiRequired: Configure AI for expiry assessment and file processing instructions. Readable post snapshots are saved first.
postParser.tip.browserIntegration: Some sites can integrate quick actions through the browser (such as one-click task creation). You can check the "Third-Party Integrations" section.
postParser.page.title: Post Parser
postParser.page.description: Save posts and first-page replies, review paid content, and extract download details and instructions for processing downloaded files for people or other tools.
postParser.page.empty: Add post URLs or paste text to extract download information. Previous results remain available here.
postParser.label.completedAtHint: Successful completion of the current parsing attempt. Reparse or retry records a new time. Unknown times in older records are shown as —.
postParser.input.title: Title (optional)
postParser.input.linksHint: One HTTP or HTTPS post URL per line. Supported sites are detected automatically; other pages use their accessible text. For pages that require a login or cannot be read, paste their text instead.
postParser.input.textHint: Paste the post, download instructions or link list, including access codes and archive passwords.
postParser.input.invalidLinks: Enter one complete HTTP or HTTPS URL per line.
postParser.input.completeForm: Enter the URLs or text to parse.
postParser.result.failed: The operation failed. Please try again.
postParser.result.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please copy the text manually.
postParser.tip.parseOnly: This only reads and extracts information. It does not download linked files or create resources automatically.
postParser.tip.workflow: Parsing runs as a workflow with execution history. For custom automation, reuse the read-content and extract-download-information nodes in workflows.
postParser.help.input: Add several post URLs or paste a post. Configure the appropriate account for supported sites that require a login.
postParser.help.parse: Select Start parsing, or enable automatic parsing after adding. The system reads the content and uses the configured AI to extract download information.
postParser.help.result: Review the result, copy links and passwords, or export Excel. To download files, add selected links to acquisition, then configure and start an acquisition workflow.
postParser.acquisition.description: Selected links become acquisition sources for one resource. Select several download links for the same resource; add different resources separately.
postParser.acquisition.title: Resource name
postParser.acquisition.noDownload: Access codes and archive passwords are preserved. Adding a resource does not start a download; choose a suitable workflow on the acquisition page.
postParser.acquisition.nextStep: Download links and passwords have been saved. Open acquisition to review the workflow and configuration before starting a download.
postParser.search.label: Search local posts
postParser.search.placeholder: Search titles, links, text or parsed results
postParser.config.autoBuyHint: Automatically buy items priced at or below this amount. The default 0 allows free items only.
postParser.config.minimumRemainingCoinsH: Purchases must leave at least this balance. Default: 0.
postParser.snapshot.scope: Saved post and first-page replies. Assessments only cover the captured content.
postParser.purchase.title: Confirm post content purchase
postParser.purchase.description: Select the items to purchase. Manual purchase overrides expiry advice and the automatic price limit; the minimum account balance still applies.
postParser.purchase.balanceUnknown: Balance is unknown. Prices and balance will be checked again before purchase. Items with unknown prices cannot be purchased here.
postParser.purchase.insufficient: This selection would reduce the account balance below the reserve.
postParser.result.partial: Partial result; some content still needs review
postParser.processing.label: After download
postParser.processing.unsupportedOperati: This operation is shown for reference and is not supported for automatic execution.
